Generated AWS API declarations and schema metadata derive from the AWS SDK for
Go v2 Smithy models. The upstream notice and Apache 2.0 license are retained in
`aws-sdk-go-v2/`. Generated catalog records identify the exact model paths,
SHA-256 digests and source revision. Stackd's service behavior is implemented
independently in Go.

Go module dependencies retain their own upstream licenses. Their versions and
checksums are pinned in go.mod and go.sum.
